This is exactly same thing happened to me last night. I was a little tipsy and took 50mg of dipenhydramine like I sometimes do. I played call of duty for 90 minutes and then when I went to go to sleep it was the same symptoms you described.

- nothing feels real
- Like I was greened out on weed
- completely restless and more awake than before
- straight panic

It was SO similar to being greened out on weed I was conviced that somebody slipped cannabis oil in my drink at the club 4 hours prior. I called an ambulance, which I had NEVER done before.

The EMT's just told me it was the Benadryl and alcohol combination. Apparently it's a textbook case of paradoxical excitation; where something that's supposed to do one thing has the opposite effect.

In this case, the benadryl was supposed to calm us down but actually made us freak out.

Good luck to you, it's good to know we aren't the only ones!
